title: Backup, restore, DR and financial recovery acceptance model
workflow: Create institution-approved backup and recovery policy with RPO/RTO requirements
Take encrypted consistent backups with key recovery scope and source evidence
Restore in isolated recovery environment with validated data integrity
Resume outbox/inbox from trusted cursors and deduplicate messages
Reconcile journal, customer balances, cash positions and external outcome cases
Reopen production traffic only on independent operations/CFO approval
invariants: Unreconciled payment outcomes cannot be considered settled due to failover
Restore cannot skip posted journal entries or modify original posting history
Recovery objectives must be measured and institution-approved, not advertised without tests
Backup copies remain encrypted and isolated from routine application permissions
Duplicate event replay cannot create duplicate financial value
Disaster recovery approval is separate from ZIP delivery or programme document acceptance
planned_tests: Restore a measured snapshot and compare source totals
Crash after posting before event publish and recover once
Test unknown external settlement after outage
Reject resumption without CFO reconciliation approval
approval_gate: Approved bank RPO/RTO, encrypted backup custody, executed restoration/fault tests and independent financial security signoff.
